hints.title: Measure one region at a time
hints.body: When you find unvisited land, every orthogonally connected land cell belongs to the same region. Count those cells before moving on.

hints.title: Flood the region
hints.body: Use a stack or queue to visit the region. Mark each cell as soon as it is added so it is counted exactly once.

hints.title: Track the maximum
hints.body: For each region, count how many cells the flood fill visits, then update the best area seen so far. The outer scan continues from the next cell.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
best = 0
for every cell:
    if cell is land and not visited:
        area = 0
        stack = [cell]
        mark cell visited
        while stack is not empty:
            current = pop(stack)
            area += 1
            for each orthogonal neighbor inside the grid:
                if neighbor is land and not visited:
                    mark visited
                    push neighbor
        best = max(best, area)
return best
```
